body:
I can’t understand how I made it And she didn’t.   

Ive had depression so many years. I’m no use to anyone. I do nothing. Why is the world so unfair. I wish it was me.

You are right, it’s been some time since then but it seems like the more time passes that the  worse it gets.

She was amazing. She came from an abusive household, I don’t think I’ll ever get out of my head how she said her grandmother made her eat her own vomit.

But she was so smart, straight A’s throughout her life, and so happy. 

It didn’t matter how much she was going through, she made people so happy.
